steps.title: Visual Cognate Mapping
steps.goal: Build immediate success and metalinguistic awareness through play. Help children see the shared DNA of English and Spanish through words that look and sound the same in both languages.

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 1 — Visual Cognate Coloring Book
books.description: This full-colour coloring book introduces young children to Perfect Cognates — words that look and sound nearly identical in English and Spanish. Through vibrant illustrations and joyful play, children discover they already know hundreds of words in both languages.
books.highlights: Ages 2-4 | 40+ perfect cognate pairs | Full color illustrations | Gift book + first biliteracy tool

steps.title: Tracing & First Words
steps.goal: Develop fine motor skills and vocabulary simultaneously. Move from visual recognition to physical production.

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 2 — Tracing & First Words, Book 1
books.description: Pairs handwriting practice with cognate-first vocabulary. Children trace letter forms and write their first bilingual words.
books.highlights: Ages 4-6 | Pen control exercises | High-frequency bilingual vocab | Cognate-first approach

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 2 — Tracing & First Words, Book 2
books.description: Extends tracing into first sentences and bilingual word families.
books.highlights: Ages 4-6 | First sentences | Bilingual word families | Builds on Book 1

steps.title: ABC Bridge — Phonics Foundations
steps.goal: Connect the alphabet to bilingual phonics. Children learn to decode sounds in both English and Spanish, anchored by cognates that make both languages feel familiar.

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 3 — ABC Bridge Workbook
books.description: Bilingual phonics and early reading readiness. Each letter is introduced through a cognate anchor word, helping children connect sounds across both languages from the start.
books.highlights: Ages 4-6 | Bilingual phonics | Alphabet mastery | Cognate-anchored sound work

steps.title: Word Families & Simple Sentences
steps.goal: Build reading fluency in both languages through word families and simple bilingual sentences. Children move from single words to connected meaning.

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 4 — Word Families & Simple Sentences
books.description: Guided bilingual reading for emerging readers. Word family patterns in English and Spanish are explored side by side, building vocabulary and early reading confidence.
books.highlights: Ages 5-7 | Bilingual word families | Simple sentence construction | Leveled reading

steps.title: Reading Comprehension Primer
steps.goal: Develop narrative comprehension and critical thinking in both languages. Children read short bilingual texts and respond with growing independence.

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 5 — Reading Comprehension Primer
books.description: Short bilingual texts with guided comprehension activities. Children build the skills to understand, discuss, and respond to stories in both English and Spanish.
books.highlights: Ages 6-8 | Bilingual comprehension | Short text reading | Critical thinking activities

steps.title: Writing & Expression
steps.goal: Achieve full biliteracy through independent writing in both languages. Children express ideas, tell stories, and write with confidence in English and Spanish.

books.title: The Biliteracy Ladder: Step 6 — Writing & Expression
books.description: The final step in the Biliteracy Bridge series. Children write independently in both languages — telling stories, expressing ideas, and demonstrating full biliteracy.
books.highlights: Ages 7-9 | Independent bilingual writing | Creative expression | Series completion
